text: [Adrian takes an envelope from the post box.]
ADRIAN: The sale goes through at noon. You were supposed to be across town.
MAYA: That's my mother's house. You can't sell it.
[Maya opens the envelope and sees a second signature.]
MAYA: Why did my mother sign this last night?
[The clerk opens the door. Maya's mother walks out holding the keys.]
MOTHER: I signed it to stop the auction. The buyer is me.
